blurb:
Niagara Fun Tours is Niagara's ONLY public wine touring company. We offer a casual touring experience that's not only affordable, but a whole lotta fun!

Starting at 10:00 AM we offer two convenient Niagara Falls pick-up options along with one option in Niagara-on-the-Lake, Canada. The choice is yours, just proceed to one of the three day of tour.

Tours operate on one of our multi-passenger buses or touring vans. Each tour includes an informative driver or tour guide.

Enjoy multiple FREE tastings at three Niagara wineries, with plenty of time to shop & explore. We also visit Trius & Wayne Gretzky wineries for shopping & exploring - samples not included.

Your tour allocates an extra hour or so for a casual lunch at either Puddicombe Farms, The Farmhouse Cafe* or Newark Brewery* - cost of meal is extra.

NOTE: Exact stops on tour subject to change without notice. *Saturday tours may visit a brewery for samples & lunch. *Weekday tours visit the Farmhouse Cafe for lunch
